table_cells.text: Check the condition of connections and seals on the suction pipe
Clean the filter cap and check the condition of the rubber seal
Check the voltage on the rating plate and that of the mains
Prevent parts from causing load loss wherever possible
Remove the motor and contact the technical service
Increased temperature in the terminal box due to electric arc
Connect the cables correctly to the junction boxes
Tighten the cable correctly to the junction box / Adapt the size of the cable connection to the junction box
